rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for something concerned with audible sound rather than images.

example.english: This is the audio part; there is no picture.
example.traditional: 呢段係聲音部分，冇畫面。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 hai6 sing1 jam1 bou6 fan6 mou5 waa2 min2

rows.note: Use this when explicitly contrasting hearing or sound with sight, especially in sensory or technical contexts.

example.english: This test compares audio and visual responses.
example.traditional: 呢個測試係比較聽覺同視覺嘅反應。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cak1 si3 hai6 bei2 gaau3 ting3 gok3 tung4 si6 gok3 ge3 faan2 jing3
